title: Three quick questions about sharing work
context: You send emails, reports and files to colleagues and clients every week.

questions.text: You were on Bcc and select Reply all. Who gets your reply?

options.feedback: Reply all also goes to everyone on To and Cc, who then see that you were on Bcc.
options.rightWhen: Reply, without "all", goes only to the sender.

options.text: The sender and everyone on To and Cc
options.feedback: Reply all copies the To and Cc lists, so everyone there sees that you were on Bcc.

options.text: Everyone, including the other Bcc recipients
options.feedback: Your email program never receives the other Bcc addresses, so it can't reply to them. Your reply goes to the sender and everyone on To and Cc.
options.rightWhen: Reply all does reach every address you can see on the email.

questions.text: Your team's sales fell 50% in March, then rose 50% in April. How do April's sales compare with February's?

options.feedback: The rise is 50% of March's smaller total, so it wins back only half of the fall. April is 25% lower than February.
options.rightWhen: A fall and a rise cancel out when they are the same amount in dollars.

options.feedback: March was half of February. Adding half of March brings April to three quarters of February, which is 25% lower.
March was half of February. Adding half of March brings April to three quarters of February.

questions.text: You draw black boxes over a client's account numbers in a PDF, save it and send it. Are the numbers hidden?

options.text: No, the text under the boxes can still be copied or searched
options.feedback: A drawn box sits on top of the text and leaves it in the file. A redaction tool deletes the text. Search for a number afterwards to check.
A drawn box sits on top of the text and leaves it in the file, where anyone can copy or search for it. A redaction tool deletes the text.
options.rightWhen: Boxes do hide the numbers on a printed page.

options.text: Yes, once the file is saved
options.feedback: Saving keeps both the boxes and the text under them, so anyone can still copy or search for the numbers. A redaction tool deletes the text.
options.rightWhen: Saving does make the change permanent after you use a redaction tool.
